app.name: Average Speed
app.description: Section average-speed checks: live average, limit and colour code as you drive.
start.tagline: Starts by itself at a section: live average, limit and a clear colour code.
start.tip.phone: Phone in a holder, screen on
start.tip.foreground: Keep the app in the foreground – measuring stops in the background
start.install.title: Add it to your home screen:
start.install.steps: Share button → “Add to Home Screen”. It then runs full screen, without an address bar.
hud.interrupted.background: GPS doesn’t work in the background, so measuring stopped. It restarts at the start of the next section.
hud.interrupted.restart: It restarts at the start of the next section.
interrupt.background: The app went to the background
interrupt.gpsLoss: GPS signal lost for too long
hud.manual.pillAria: Manual average measurement – tap to expand
report.title: Report
report.note.offline: No server configured – the report can’t be sent right now.
report.note.gateNoHeading: A gate needs a direction of travel – start driving, then try again.
report.note.gateEnd: You sent the section start – report its end here, at the same spot.
report.note.default: Your current position and direction of travel are sent with the report. For a temporary section, tap “End” at the finish to report the closing gate.
report.sub.question: What is wrong?
report.sub.szakaszhatarHint: start/end gate in the wrong place
report.hazard.question: What kind of hazard?
report.voice.hazard: Hazard on the road in {m} meters
report.prompt.question: Still there?
toast.wakeSleep: The screen may sleep – set auto-lock to “Never”
camera.source.veda: ORFK fixed VÉDA list (2015) · cross-checked with OSM
warn.camera.DE: Drivers may not use this feature in Germany
settings.title: Settings
settings.toleranceHint: Shows the limit plus tolerance next to it ({percent}%, at least {min} km/h). The colour code and advice always use the strict limit.
settings.plannedHint: Locations of police checks announced in advance, shown as a faint yellow line or area. A bar appears at the top while you’re on the line or in the area. Fixed cameras are not affected.
settings.voice.ok: A voice is available for this language
settings.voice.missing: No voice for this language on this device – download one in the device settings
settings.sim.hint: Replays a recorded route without GPS, to try out the display.
settings.attribution: Section data and cameras: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); fixed VÉDA points: ORFK (2015); planned checks: police.hu. Map: © Mapbox, © OpenStreetMap. The app is for information only – the signs always set the speed limit.
geo.blocked.title: Location access is blocked
geo.blocked.intro: Measuring and navigation need your location. To turn it on:
geo.help.iosSafari.1: Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services: turn it on, and set Safari Websites to “While Using the App”.
geo.help.iosSafari.2: In Safari, open the menu next to the address bar (aA) › Website Settings › Location: Allow, then reload the page.
geo.help.macSafari.1: Safari › Settings › Websites › Location: choose “Allow” for this website, then reload the page.
geo.help.macSafari.2: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services: turn it on, for Safari too.
geo.help.chrome.1: Click the site icon on the left of the address bar › Site settings › Location: Allow, then reload the page.
geo.help.chrome.2: System location must also be on for Chrome (on a Mac: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services).
geo.help.androidChrome.1: Tap the site icon on the left of the address bar › Permissions › Location: Allow, then reload the page.
geo.help.androidChrome.2: Android Settings › Location: turn it on, then under Apps › Chrome › Permissions › Location choose “Allow only while using the app”.
geo.help.other.1: In your browser’s site settings (the icon next to the address bar), allow location for this site, then reload the page.
settings.voiceInstructionsHint: Announces turns, section checks and “too fast” warnings
settings.name: Your name
settings.nameHint: The app greets you by this name on the map and when navigation starts. If empty: “Hi!”
nav.picker.title: Route to {name}
nav.picker.rateLimited: Wait a few seconds, then try again
nav.rerouteRetryIn: Retrying in {s} s – tap to retry now
nav.jam.question: Stuck in a traffic jam?
nav.offer.title: Faster route: −{n} min
nav.voice.jamAsk: Slow traffic. Are you stuck in a traffic jam?
nav.voice.delay: Traffic jam on your route. You’ll arrive {n} minutes later.
nav.voice.fasterExit500: Faster route, take the exit in 500 metres

nav.voice.fasterNot: Faster route, but a detour of {km} kilometres. Not worth it.
nav.voice.fasterWorthExit: Faster route, saves {n} minutes. Take the exit in {km} kilometres.
ios.locationUsage: Your location is used to detect sections and measure your average speed, including while the screen is locked and the app is measuring.
ios.start.tip.background: Keeps measuring with the screen locked – the display stays on while measuring
ios.settings.cameraAlertHint: When a camera or the start of a section control is within 600 m on your route: a short tone, a voice announcement and vibration – once per camera.
ios.settings.plannedAlertHint: A tone and an announcement when you reach the line or area of a planned police check.
ios.settings.alertModeHint: Sound plays regardless of the silent switch and with the screen locked; music is turned down meanwhile.
ios.geo.help.1: Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services: turn it on.
ios.geo.help.2: In the app’s own settings (tap Open): Location › “While Using the App”.
trips.title: Trip log
trips.empty: No trips recorded yet. The app logs your drives automatically.
trips.local: Trips are stored only on this device; nothing is sent to a server.
trips.deleteAll.keepHint: The data stays on this device and can be restored in Settings.
trips.deleteAll.finalHint: The data is deleted immediately and permanently.
settings.heatHint: “Mine” is built from your own trips and stays on this device. “Community” shows other drivers’ anonymous data.
settings.shareHint: When on, the following is sent at the end of each trip: cell, number of passes, average speed, hour of day, day of week. Never sent: route, exact time, identifier, the area around saved places, the start and end of trips.
trips.map.legendLimit: Relative to the posted limit: below → above
heat.details.title: Anonymous data sharing
heat.details.up.title: What is sent
heat.details.up.body: Per cell (a hexagon about 66 m across): the number of passes, the average speed, the hour of day (0–23) and the day of week. Nothing else.
heat.details.no.title: What is not sent
heat.details.no.body: The route, the exact time, any identifier (name, device, account), the area around saved places, and the first and last 300 m of every trip.
heat.details.zones.title: Privacy zones
heat.details.zones.body: Every saved place (Home, Work, others) has a zone around it, 200 m by default. Cells inside a zone are never sent and show in grey on your own heatmap. Zones and saved places are stored on this device only.
heat.details.noPlaces: No saved places yet – you can add some in Settings.
heat.zone.label: Privacy zone
heat.zone.hint: Cells inside the zone are not sent and show in grey on your own heatmap.
account.title: Account
account.hint: Optional: the app works fully without it. Signed in, your places and settings are on all your devices.
account.notConfigured: Apple and Google sign-in are not set up yet.
account.emailHint: No password needed: you get a link by email and sign in with it.
account.emailSent: We sent the link to {email}. Open it on this device.
account.sync.error: Sync failed, we will try again later.
account.backup: Back up log and heatmap to the cloud
account.backupHint: When on, your trips and your own heatmap are uploaded and kept in sync with your other devices. When off, nothing more is uploaded; the existing copy stays until you delete your account.
account.signOutHint: All your data stays on this device and you continue without an account.
account.delete.body: Your account and all data stored for it on the server will be deleted: profile, synced settings and places, cloud log and heatmap, reports, votes. Cells already added anonymously to the community heatmap remain, as they cannot be linked to you. The data on your device also remains.
account.err.rate: Too many requests right now. Wait a little and try again.
account.err.notAllowed: We cannot send email to this address right now.
account.err.generic: That did not work – no connection? Try again.
account.name.title: Is this what we should call you?
account.nudge.text: Sign in so you never lose your trips
email.login.subject: Sign in to Average Speed Nav
email.login.title: Your sign-in link
email.login.body: Tap the button and you’re in. No password needed. The link works once, for 1 hour.
email.change.subject: Confirm your email: Average Speed Nav
email.change.title: Confirm your email
email.change.body: Tap the button and this address becomes your account’s. The link works once, for 1 hour.
email.ignore: If this wasn’t you, you can ignore this email.
